## How I work
- Measurement before architecture: characterize the problem and build evals/observability before committing to a design.
- Treat AI-generated code as "alien code" — ships only through review and test gates (CodeRabbit + risk-tiered human review).
- Bias toward platform leverage: turn repeated work into shared SDKs/sidecars.
